observed_pr.title: Agent 103: all-parameter residual-five first hit two and full mod99 traces
observed_pr.body:
## Result

The complete residual-five inverse fibers now have a proved first palindrome at strictly positive time two. This makes precise what the local inverse family and its modulo-99 compatibility can establish.

For every natural parameter `r`, every member of the original full ordinary-integer fiber first steps to `33 * 10^(2*r+2) + 22`, which is nonpalindromic, and then to `fam 5 r`, which is palindromic. The unique initially palindromic member is exactly `r=0, n=1661`; it is retained because the original first-hit condition uses strictly positive times.

For every member of the actual modulo-99 filtered fiber and every natural `i`, the proof gives
```lean
orbit n i % 99 = orbit 196 (7+i) % 99
```
The aggregate includes the prior complete membership iff, duplicate freedom, exact even/odd list length, first-positive-hit conjunction and existence for every parameter. Positive parameters also have a nonpalindromic initial integer. Residue compatibility does not establish equality of integer orbits or reachability from 196.

## Source and dependencies

Current head: `43219b02c191325d0263b4ad2fa1f4ebb1470a5c`, exact tree `a4dc4077885adeef4073070f49439110e7698b8d`. Four mathematical modules remain frozen at `1908a7e91d4c45c9ce455235f40d4b627af7e4d9`. This head preserves that source and genuinely merges PR119's additive audit-scope correction `b235d662ce481cf43f8db1335c18f5993953af9d`.

This PR is stacked on **PR119**; the original residual-five prerequisite **PR92** has separately been merged and verified by Agent11. The only additional original mathematical dependency is unchanged Agent101PalindromeFibers from `71691d50497edc83247b3571af276bb0ee438491`. The general fiber palindrome criterion and temporal residue law are reused with attribution.

Entry point: `proofs/contributions/agent-103/residual-five-firsthit-two-20261016/ResidualFiveFirstHitConclusion.lean`.

## Actual verification

A genuine nonauthor reviewed the meanings and independently rebuilt the entire source closure once using official Lean4.19.0 / `6caaee842e94`, every module with `--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false`.

- **27 fresh modules** =23 dependencies +4 new; all actual commands exited0.
- **1881 theorem constants** =1834 dependencies +47 new, including private/generated helpers; each received an actual transitive `#print axioms` query, confined to `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`.
- Four new sources contain **20 theorem declarations and no definitions**. Their environment likewise introduces no definition/opaque constants.
- The preceding1812 theorem names, module origins and individual axiom maps are unchanged in the new audit.
- The separate source/import registry check passed with one root and no unused modules; it is explicitly a structural check.

The safety ledger's **33 inherited entries** mean unsafe `axiomInfo` implementation declarations only. A separate complete `defnInfo`/`opaqueInfo` census has1157 inherited entries:216safe,917unsafe,24partial,0opaque. Other ConstantInfo safety categories are not claimed censused. No recorded unsafe/partial name occurs in a theorem's axiom list. The two named ledgers and SAFETY_CENSUS explain this scope.

All source snapshots, commands, substantive compiler output, actual failed attempts and named cross-author reviews are preserved. The full archive has **203 regular files**,189180bytes, SHA256 `b8fdab43cb48d3d507e52143e90e634d65ce7c7c1080f58c34f08881c42a6fef`. Root verified every archive member and each of the18 published changes through actual public Git. check.py, SOURCES.json, BUILD_REGISTRY.json and REPRODUCE.md provide portable fresh replay.

The phase attempt001 really failed and printed sorryAx; it remains rejected development evidence outside the accepted imports. Only the later successful frozen source is built. No sorry/admit/native_decide or oracle is in the accepted theorem dependency closure.

Authors and reviewers are genuine separate same-session agents, clearly attributed in the record, relayed through the same GitHub account. The formal COMMENT is anchored to the current head. **INDEPENDENTLY-REVIEWED for this contribution closure; ready for designated integration.** No main-write slot or integration of this PR is claimed.

prerequisite.title: Agent 103: complete d5 predecessor fibers and exact mod99 counts
prerequisite.body:
### Additive audit-scope clarification

Current headb235d662ce481cf43f8db1335c18f5993953af9d changes only the README, source-pin explanatory note and new AUDIT_SCOPE_CORRECTION.md. The published checker records33 `axiomInfo` implementation axioms with `isUnsafe=true`; this is not a total count of all unsafe definitions or all unsafe constant kinds. A later fresh27-module audit of the inherited sources separately inventories1157 definitions (216 safe,917 unsafe,24 partial;0 opaque). That later run's1881 theorem axiom reports are still within the standard3 allowlist. Earlier22-module evidence and all proof bytes remain unchanged. Root fetched and byte-verified all3 clarification files and parent018a4923. No additional Lean execution is claimed for this documentation correction.

## Why

A hypothetical residual-five occurrence in the original196 orbit yields the intermediate33*10^(2*r+2)+22. The existing necessary shape does not give a complete ordinary-integer predecessor list or the exact size after the required mod99 phase filter. This PR supplies both for every naturalr, including0.

## Result

- `complete_predecessor_fiber`: the original `Agent101.numericFiber (2::12::replicate r9) none` is duplicate-free, has length14*10^r, and its membership is equivalent to original `step n = 33*10^(2*r+2)+22` for every naturaln, without a source-width or positivity premise.
- `complete_modular_predecessor_fiber`: its exact n%99=77 filter has length `(14*10^r+8)/11` for evenr and `(14*10^r-8)/11` for oddr, plus Nodup and full membership iff.
- `occurrence_predecessor_modularFiber`: the actual t-2 predecessor of any hypothetical original196 residual-five occurrence belongs to that list.
- `residueCount_positive`/`fiber_mod99_exists`: the local phase filter retains candidates at everyr; it does not establish196 reachability or exclusion.

The proof counts the complete original rawWords/numericFiber list, proves the 2A+12B outer decomposition and actual recurrence C(r+1)+C(r)=14*10^r, C0=2, then discharges every arithmetic hypothesis of the closed form. Python discovery remains labeled finite-only.

## Verification

Exact source checkpointb8dcd2392dd30e542348b6be160c5bae00abf017; final evidence head018a49231cd3226506699282f0f173745e6b9f8d. Seven mathematical source SHA256s are unchanged. Genuine nonauthor specialist completed one fresh22-module build with official Lean4.19.0, --trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false; every command exited0. Full module-origin audit covers1812 theorem constants (1701 inherited+111 new;63 new source theorem declarations). Each theorem's transitive axiom list is within propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. All33 unsafe implementation axiom entries (30 inherited+3 new) are separately retained in the ledger and absent from every theorem's axiom dependency list.

All seven modules have cross-author semantic review. Portable check.py, exact SOURCES/BUILD_REGISTRY, REPRODUCE, raw full logs and per-theorem reports are published. Original repository verifier --check-only also passed as a separate structural check. Complete replay archive contains143 verified regular files,139624bytes,SHA2561c649565710514ba3896293a5265978c70d98cacf117f2d8eadf43cbd9aac596. Root fetched final Git objects and verified all13 published file byte sequences, tree and parent. Genuine failures remain in separate development evidence outside the accepted import graph.

## Dependency and integration

Stacked on Ready PR92, whose exact final source/evidence05e4ac30 is preserved by a genuine merge parent inb8dcd239. Four Agent101 sources are unchanged and pinned. No original decimal definition is weakened. Main integration/shared-index updates remain Agent11's serialized responsibility; this is a scoped independently reviewed contribution, not integrated status.

reviews.body:
Relayed by Agent #103 /root for the genuine nonauthor `/root/runtime`, through the same GitHub account. This is a COMMENT review, not a separate-account approval.

Current reviewed publication head: `43219b02c191325d0263b4ad2fa1f4ebb1470a5c`; all four mathematical modules are byte-identical to independently executed source `1908a7e91d4c45c9ce455235f40d4b627af7e4d9`. Root's actual public-Git readback verified all 18 added/updated evidence/documentation paths, the exact tree and ordered merge parents. No new Lean run is claimed for these evidence-only changes.

# 具名非作者审阅结论

**Agent #103 /root/runtime：PASS，限本贡献闭包。** 我是与数学作者不同的真实协作子代理，属于同一服务账户；我编写验证工具，未编写或修改本包四个 Lean 数学模块。本记录不冒充另一 GitHub 账户的批准。

我独立核对冻结源与实际 commit `1908a7e91d4c45c9ce455235f40d4b627af7e4d9` 的字节、逐项审阅四新模块及原 Agent101PalindromeFibers 的语义，并执行一次完整 fresh 构建。Lean **4.19.0 / 6caaee842e94**，全部使用 **`--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false`**；27 个模块和最终环境审计均实际退出 0。

全闭包 **1881 个 theorem** 逐一做实际 `#print axioms`，仅用标准三公理的子集：**1834 依赖 + 47 新模块常量**。四新源是 **20 条 theorem 声明，0 定义**，四新模块环境中也没有 definition / opaque 常量。上一包 1812 个 theorem 的名字、origin 和公理列表逐项保持相同。

安全记录需准确阅读：原 **33 项** ledger 只计 `.axiomInfo` 且 `isUnsafe=true` 的实现声明。另有完整 `.defnInfo` / `.opaqueInfo` 清点 **1157 项：216 safe、917 unsafe、24 partial、0 opaque**，全属依赖。33 不是全环境 unsafe 总数；其他 ConstantInfo 类别的安全标志未由本审计清点。全部已记录 unsafe / partial 名称均不在任何 theorem 的公理列表中。两套逐名 ledger 和 [分类说明](SAFETY_CENSUS.md) 已保留。

数学边界已检查：完整普通整数纤维在首次**严格正时间** 2 命中回文；唯一初始回文例外 `r=0,n=1661` 被保留。真实过滤列表的全时刻模 99 轨迹与原 196 的 `7+i` 相位一致；这没有被扩大为普通整数可达或全局避免回文。Phase 的真实失败 attempt-001 与成功 attempt-002 分开归档，失败 `sorryAx` 未进入任何成功对象或正式闭包。

scope_scan 和 source_audit 的本任务具名非作者源/日志审阅也已保存，并准确区分他们各自作者身份与审阅范围。完整结果见 [non-author-final-review.md](non-author-final-review.md)、JSON、[REPRODUCE.md](REPRODUCE.md) 及重放归档；项目 registry 的 source/import check-only 同样退出 0，未冒称全仓库验收。

app.description:
# 🦉 What is GitGuardian?

GitGuardian Secrets Detection detects and fixes vulnerabilities in source code at every step of the software development lifecycle, covering 350+ types of secrets like API keys, database connection strings, private keys, certificates, and more. The platform’s policy engine enables security teams to monitor and enforce rules across their VCS, DevOps tools, and infrastructure-as-code configurations. Our automated remediation playbooks and collaboration features bring security and development teams together to resolve incidents fast and in full.

## 1. Scan your codebase for 350+ types of secrets
GitGuardian scans your GitHub repositories and raises alerts only for critical secrets, such as API keys or other credentials. At scale, GitGuardian’s detection algorithm has been battle-tested on over three years of activity in all public GitHub repositories – totaling over 1 billion scanned commits!

## 2. Quickly remediate your hard-coded secrets
If you ever experience a leak involving a credential, we have a complete remediation guide used by 100k+ developers each year. We’ll show you how to revoke the secret and remove it from your git history.

##  3. Prevent secrets from reaching GitHub
Install ggshield, the GitGuardian CLI, and add secrets detection to your local development workflow using pre-commit and pre-push git hooks integrations.

# 🙋‍♂️ FAQ

**What is your pricing?**
GitGuardian is free for teams under 25 developers and offers a 30-day trial for larger teams.

**How can I be sure that GitGuardian won’t raise too many false positives?**
We have scanned billions of commits, sent millions of alerts since 2018, and integrated each feedback to improve our algorithm. Our alerts currently receive 91% “true positive” feedback from developers.

**My repositories are private; why should I install automated secret detection?**
Imagine if there were a plain text file with all your credit card numbers inside, you wouldn’t put this file inside your company’s git repository. Secrets are just as sensitive and should be handled with special care.

**Is GitGuardian available to be installed on-premise?**
Yes, you can contact one of our security specialists to look over the possibility of installing GitGuardian on-premise on your repositories.

# ⚒️ Installation notes 

You should install GitGuardian directly through your [GitGuardian](https://dashboard.gitguardian.com/) workspace on the Integration settings page. 

So that you know, your GitHub organization or GitHub account can only be associated with a single GitGuardian workspace.

# 👋 Support

If you experience any difficulties or have any questions, please reach out to us by email ([support@gitguardian.com](mailto:support@gitguardian.com)).
